# arthron

> A fetch client assembled from plugins. Returns native `Response`; middleware controls flow (can retry via `next`), interceptors transform values. Zero dependencies, ESM + CJS, Node 18+ and browsers.

Import: `import { arthron, retry, timeout, logging, isArthronError, definePlugin } from "arthron";`

## Create

```ts
const api = arthron({
  baseURL?: string,              // prefix for relative paths; required unless you pass absolute URLs
  headers?: HeadersInit,         // defaults, per-call headers win (case-insensitive)
  credentials?: RequestCredentials, // NOT set unless you set it
  fetch?: typeof fetch,          // injection for tests/polyfills, resolved per request
  use?: Plugin[],                // plugins, outermost first
  errorMessage?: (data: unknown, res: Response) => string | undefined,
});
```

## Request

```ts
api.get(path, init?) | api.delete(path, init?) | api.head(path, init?)
api.post(path, body?, init?) | api.put(path, body?, init?) | api.patch(path, body?, init?) | api.query(path, body?, init?)   // QUERY = RFC 10008
api.request(path, { method, body?, ...init })      // method is required here
// init = RequestInit minus method/body, plus params?: Record<string, string|number|boolean|null|undefined>
```

Every method returns `Promise<Response>` plus helpers:
`.json<T>()` `.text()` `.blob()` `.arrayBuffer()` `.formData()` `.sse(): AsyncIterable<{event?,data,id?,retry?}>` `.ndjson<T>(): AsyncIterable<T>`

- Body: string/FormData/Blob/ArrayBuffer/URLSearchParams/ReadableStream sent as-is (matched by type tag, so polyfill/cross-realm instances count; streams get `duplex: "half"`). Any other value (incl. null) → JSON + `content-type: application/json` unless you set one. GET/HEAD with body → TypeError.
- URL: `baseURL` + path by string concatenation (`"https://a/v1" + "/u"` → `https://a/v1/u`). Absolute path bypasses baseURL. `params` appended with `&` if a query exists, placed before `#fragment`.
- Argument errors (no baseURL, URL fetch cannot parse, BigInt body, missing method) reject the promise with TypeError before fetch; they do not throw synchronously and are never retried.
- `.sse()`/`.ndjson()`: leaving the loop early cancels the body. `.sse()` drops an event the stream ends inside (spec).

## Errors

```ts
class ArthronError extends Error {
  status: number;        // HTTP status, 0 = network failure
  statusText: string;
  headers: Headers;
  data: unknown;         // JSON if parseable, else text, else undefined
  response?: Response;   // original, still readable; absent for network failure
  request: { url: string; init: RequestInit };
  cause?: unknown;       // underlying error for network failure
}
isArthronError(e): e is ArthronError
```

- Only `!response.ok` and fetch rejection become ArthronError. Aborts (`AbortError`/`TimeoutError` or any custom `abort(reason)`, including during the error-body read) and exceptions thrown by plugins propagate untouched and skip error interceptors.
- Default message: body `message` → `error` (string) → `error.message` → `detail` → `"Request failed with status N"`. Override with `errorMessage`.

## Plugins

```ts
type Plugin = {
  name?: string;
  middleware?: (ctx, next: (ctx) => Promise<Response>) => Promise<Response>; // wraps the call; may call next again (retry) or not at all
  request?: (ctx) => ctx;                      // per attempt, before fetch
  response?: (res, ctx) => Response;           // per successful attempt; body is single-use, clone() to peek
  error?: (err: ArthronError, ctx) => ArthronError; // per failed attempt; return value is always thrown
};
type RequestContext = { url: string; init: RequestInit };
```

Order: `middleware[0]( middleware[1]( attempt: request interceptors → fetch → response | error interceptors ) )`. Each attempt gets a fresh copy of ctx (headers, and a FormData/URLSearchParams body).

`api.use(...plugins)` and `api.extend(config)` return NEW clients; the original is unchanged.

Helpers (identity, for typing): `definePlugin(p)`, `defineMiddleware(m)`, `defineInterceptor.request(f) / .response(f) / .error(f)`.

## Built-in plugins

- `retry({ retries=2, retryOn=[408,429,500,502,503,504], methods=[GET,HEAD,OPTIONS,QUERY,PUT,DELETE], delay=(n)=>300*2**n, maxRetryAfter=60000 })` — re-runs the whole attempt (request interceptors included). Honours Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date). Never retries ReadableStream bodies, aborted requests, non-ArthronErrors. `retries` must be a whole number ≥ 0 (TypeError otherwise); waits are capped at 2^31-1 ms.
- `timeout(ms)` — deadline from attempt start until the body is fully read. Rejects with TimeoutError (not ArthronError; retry ignores it). Place after `retry` for per-attempt, before it for total. `Infinity` = no deadline; NaN/negative/>2^31-1 → TypeError. Keeps `res.url`/`redirected`/`type`; timer is unref'd.
- `logging({ enabled=true, logger=console, onEvent?, now? })` — start/success/error lines or structured events `{ phase, method, path, status?, ms?, error? }`. Never prints query strings or userinfo. Does not log cancellations.

## Recipes

Auth refresh (middleware retries, interceptor adds header; retried attempt picks up the new token automatically):
```ts
const auth = (store) => definePlugin({
  request: (ctx) => store.token() ? { ...ctx, init: { ...ctx.init, headers: { ...ctx.init.headers, authorization: `Bearer ${store.token()}` } } } : ctx,
  middleware: async (ctx, next) => { try { return await next(ctx); } catch (e) { if (!isArthronError(e) || e.status !== 401) throw e; await store.refresh(); return next(ctx); } },
});
```

Streaming an LLM response:
```ts
for await (const { data } of api.post("/v1/chat/completions", { model, messages, stream: true }).sse()) {
  if (data === "[DONE]") break;          // provider sentinel, not handled by arthron
  const chunk = JSON.parse(data);
}
```

## Non-goals

No request/response key transformation, no caching, no dedupe, no upload progress, no backend-envelope unwrapping. Do those in your adapter layer.
